text: player
Rallying
Ichihime
We made it out alive...
I thought that was the end for us there...
Asuna
Is everyone okay? Any injuries?
We're okay, thanks to everyone's help.
Kirito
Whew... This looks like a safe zone. Sorry about that, I didn't get a chance to properly introduce myself before.
I'm Kirito. The girl holding the rapier is Asuna, and next to her is my sister, Leafa. Over by the window with the sniper rifle is Sinon.
Honestly, Kirito, this is what you get for rushing into a sketchy quest... I expect you to do some serious reflecting when we get back.
Sinon
More importantly... we can observe the enemy's movements from this window here.
Those monsters don't seem particularly intelligent, but there are a lot of them. Charging in would be too dangerous, I'm afraid.
Leafa
We'll have to proceed with caution then. Let's fully prepare ourselves before making any moves.
I brought some HP-recovery items! Should we have a rest first? I have bread and cream here as well.
Ooh, Asuna is so nice! I wanna try some bread with cream on top too, nyaa! Oh, right, I'm Ichihime, and this here's my Master, nyaa!
It's good to meet you all. You guys seem to make a well-balanced team.
Yui Yagi
Agreed. I feel safer already.
Eh?! When did you...
...Monsters blocked my route home. Besides, I was worried about you, senpai, so I came back.
I won't be much help as a combatant, but I could help analyze the battles.
Thank you, Yui.//nEveryone, we've got an analyst on our side too.
Yui
Hello! I'm Papa and Mama's Navigation Pixie, Yui. Nice to meet you!
Nyaa, nyaa?! She's so tiny...! She's a pixie, nyaa?!
She can help analyze our battles and provide key intel for clearing each stage.//nWe'll be relying on you as always, Yui.
You got it, Papa! I started my analysis when we entered this world, and it's actually complete now.
"This world"? Where exactly are we...?
Here come the results, Mama. This isn't the same as Mama and Papa's world... this is another world.
And this isn't a game, either – it's a reality that's fused with game data.
Fused with game data...?
That's right... It seems that something went wrong with the VR game you were playing, and some of its data was integrated into the real world. That's why monsters are spawning in the streets.
...Sounds like a pretty serious problem.

My guess is that certain energies from this world leaked into the virtual space, and that this kind of power can even affect the virtual spaces of other worlds... to the point that it caused everyone's game avatars to be transported into this world.
Nyaaow yow... You're starting to lose me, nyaa!
If we don't do something about this power, the monsters won't just consume this world, but other worlds as well. Meaning...
Meaning that, worst case scenario... our world will also be affected?
Oh no...
Looks like we have no choice. We have to do something.
Hm... In that case, we'll have to do our part, too. And here come more of our friends.
Natsuki Shinomiya
Hmph... I never thought I'd see the day that this world begins to merge with the abyss. And you, dark knight – the aura of your blade sent shivers down my very spine!
Huh? Me? You mean my Sword Skill?

"Sword Skill"... what a splendid term! I am White Night, and I too, am capable of creating miracles! Since fate has brought us together, perhaps our souls will resonate – not just in mahjong, but in swordsmanship as well!
Um, so, White Night is the name of Natsuki's in-game character...
You even changed into White Night's gear?!
Hehe... Ahahahaha! Evil monsters are roaming the streets, and this world is in desperate need of salvation – that is the cue for White Night and his beloved sword Luminas to take the stage!
You're saying weird things again, nyaa...//nKirito, you can just ignore him, nyaa.
Haha... I can sense how much that sword means to him, though. Besides, we all share the same desire to protect our own worlds.
You mean...! You can actually see into the soul of my beloved Luminas! We were destined to fight side by side!
Ahaha... Looks like you two will be fast friends, Kirito.
Wanjirou
I'm with you guys, we gotta put things back on track. This is our world, so we gotta protect it together, woof.
Wanjirou... You're right! Let's do this, everyone!
I agree with you, but how do we do this? Anyone have any leads?
Indeed... We can't just fight these monsters one by one, can we?
That reminds me, I think Kaguyahime mentioned something earlier...
Maybe Mahjong Soul Shrine has the answer?
How do the results look...?
Analysis complete! The strongest source of this power in all of One Han City... is Mahjong Soul Shrine!
Mahjong Soul Shrine... According to Kaguyahime, that's her territory now.
...Right, looks like our objective is clear now.
To protect our world... and to help return yours to normal.
We'll reclaim Mahjong Soul Shrine and defeat the final boss – Kaguyahime!
Everyone
Let's go!!
Scouting complete, Papa! This area is safe, I didn't find any enemies!
I see. Running a keyword analysis on {var:player_nickname}'s statement now...
